about.details_body_1: Also known in the fandom as Aster (归星) @AsterTheDragon, Chee Yao is the one inviting everyone to this special event!
about.details_body_2: Described as a Blueberry Pie who loves Mangos, he welcomes fellow furs to gather for a great night of food and hanging out in Malaysia.

project.title: Built for Yao Yao's dinner at Gao Ren Guan
project.intro: This website is a personally operated, free, non-commercial project made specifically for Yao Yao (Chee Yao / Aster 归星) and friends gathering for dinner at 高人馆 · Gao Ren Guan in Subang Jaya — keeping seats, pre-orders, and table bills organized without spreadsheet or group-chat chaos.

features.gatherings_body: Keep the dinner time, pre-order deadline, and Gao Ren Guan venue details in one place for everyone attending.
features.spaces_title: Gao Ren Guan floor plan & tables
features.spaces_body: Browse the ground-floor and first-floor tables at Gao Ren Guan to see where you are sitting and who is at your table.
features.codes_body: Use the shared dinner PIN and your table's access code so invited friends can claim their seat without sign-up forms.
features.memories_body: Post messages, upload photos from the night, and leave emoji reactions on the shared feedback wall.
features.preorders_title: Pre-order from the Gao Ren Guan menu
features.preorders_body: Browse the restaurant menu in four languages, add dietary notes, pre-order dishes for your table, and split the bill fairly.
features.archive_body: Preserve a read-only archive of past Yao Yao dinners, table rosters, popular dishes, and shared moments.

project.identity_title: No accounts, passwords, or email registration
project.identity_body_1: This website intentionally does not use traditional user accounts, passwords, or email sign-ups. You unlock the dinner with a shared PIN and join your table with its table code.
project.identity_body_2: Names on a table roster or the feedback wall are shared, unverified identifiers used only to organize seats and food orders. Claiming or typing a username does not verify or establish anyone's real-world identity.

legal.title: Legal, Privacy & Guidelines
legal.subtitle: Plain-language notes on how the Yao Yao Dinner website works.

privacy.title: Privacy Notice
privacy.summary: What information is stored when you join a table, pre-order food, or post photos.
privacy.intro: This is a personally operated, non-commercial website built specifically for friends attending Yao Yao's dinner at 高人馆 · Gao Ren Guan. We keep data collection to the bare minimum needed to run the dinner.

items.no_accounts_body: We do not ask for or store email addresses, passwords, phone numbers, real legal names, or payment details.
items.shared_info_title: What is visible to other guests
items.shared_info_body: Display names, optional avatars, dietary notes, food orders, bill splits, and feedback wall posts or photos you submit are visible to everyone with the dinner PIN.
items.device_storage_body: We do not use advertising trackers or analytics cookies. Your browser's localStorage simply remembers your language, theme, dinner PIN, table code, and selected roster name on your device.
items.removal_body: Dinner data and uploaded images are stored using cloud database and storage providers (Neon, Upstash, AWS, and Cloudflare), and the About page embeds Google Maps for Gao Ren Guan's location. You can edit or remove your roster info while the dinner is open, or contact the host anytime to have a name, note, or photo deleted.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.summary: Simple ground rules for using the Yao Yao Dinner website.
terms.intro: By using this website to join a table, pre-order food from Gao Ren Guan, or post on the feedback wall, you agree to a few straightforward ground rules.

items.non_commercial_body: This website is provided free of charge as a personal project for Yao Yao's dinner gatherings. It is offered on an as-is, best-effort basis and may be updated or paused at any time.
items.access_codes_title: Keep the dinner PIN & table codes private
items.access_codes_body: The dinner PIN and table codes are meant only for invited friends attending the dinner. Please do not share them publicly or attempt to access tables or admin tools you were not invited to use.
items.unverified_names_body: Guest names are unverified labels chosen by attendees. Because anyone with a table code can add or claim a name at that table, usernames do not establish real-world identity.
items.bills_title: No payments happen on this site
items.bills_body: Gao Ren Guan menu prices and bill splits shown here are estimates to help your table coordinate. Actual payment happens in person with your table host or at the restaurant.

guidelines.title: Community Guidelines
guidelines.summary: Keep the table rosters and feedback wall friendly and welcoming.
guidelines.intro: This space exists so Yao Yao's friends and fellow furs can relax, eat well at Gao Ren Guan, and enjoy the night together. Please help keep it welcoming for everyone.

items.be_kind_body: Treat fellow guests, table hosts, and Gao Ren Guan staff with kindness. Harassment, hate speech, or mean-spirited posts have no place here.
items.appropriate_posts_body: Only upload feedback photos, profile pictures, and notes that are safe for all attendees. Ask friends before posting close-up photos of them.
items.respect_tables_title: Don't mess with other people's seats or orders
items.respect_tables_body: Only unlock the table you are actually sitting at, and only claim your own name. Never edit or delete someone else's food order without asking them.
items.moderation_body: Yao Yao and the dinner admins can remove inappropriate posts or photos, adjust table rosters, or reset table codes if needed to keep the dinner running smoothly.

preorder.title: Food Pre-order Rules
preorder.summary: How Gao Ren Guan ordering stages, shared dishes, dietary notes, and bill splits work.
preorder.intro: To help 高人馆 · Gao Ren Guan prepare food on time for all of our tables, ordering moves through clear stages before and during the dinner.

items.stages_body: While pre-ordering is open, you can add or edit dishes for your table. Once pre-orders are confirmed at the deadline, pre-orders lock so Gao Ren Guan's kitchen can prepare in advance. Extra dishes ordered at the restaurant can be added during dinner before the bill is finalized.
items.splitting_body: When adding a dish, you can assign it to just yourself, specific tablemates, or the whole table. Preset set menus or included items follow the table's shared split rules shown on the Splits tab.
items.dietary_notes_body: Adding a note like "no shrimp" to your roster profile helps your tablemates pick dishes, but notes are not sent automatically to Gao Ren Guan's kitchen. Always inform restaurant staff directly about allergies.
items.changes_title: Check your order before the lock
items.changes_body: Because pre-ordered food is prepared specifically for your table at Gao Ren Guan, please double-check quantities and options before the deadline and tell your table host promptly if your plans change.

contact.title: Contact / Report an Issue
contact.summary: Who to reach out to for help, bug reports, or removing a photo or post.
contact.intro: Need a hand with your table, spotted a bug, or want a photo, note, or feedback post removed? Reach out directly and we'll sort it out.

items.report_issue_title: Report a post, photo, or table issue
items.report_issue_body: If someone posted an unwanted photo on the feedback wall or made a mistake on your table's roster or orders, message Yao Yao or an admin at the dinner.
items.content_removal_body: Want your display name, avatar, or feedback post removed from the current or a past Yao Yao dinner? Contact the host via the social links below and it will be removed promptly.
items.host_help_body: The dinner is hosted by Chee Yao (Yao Yao / Aster 归星). For technical issues or website help, reach out to hatohui on X (@_Hatohui), Telegram (hatohui), Bluesky (hatohui), or Facebook (hatohui).
items.self_service_body: Tapped "That's me" on the wrong person or joined the wrong table? You can log out from the top-right name menu or tap the Leave Table button anytime.

faq.title: Questions & answers
faq.subtitle: Stuck on something? It's probably answered here.
faq.wrong_identity_q: I tapped "That's me" on the wrong person. Help!
faq.wrong_identity_a: No worries. Open the menu with your name in the top bar and choose Log out. Then join your table again with its code and tap "That's me" next to the right name.
faq.table_code_q: Where do I get my table's code?
faq.table_code_a: Ask someone sitting at your table, or the host. Open your table, tap "I'm at this table" and type the code in.
faq.find_table_q: How do I find my table?
faq.find_table_a: Go to Tables and search for the table name or your own name. Your table is marked "You're here", and Map view shows where it is in the room.
faq.order_a: Open your table, go to Orders and tap Add order. You'll need to join your table with its code first.
faq.split_a: The Splits tab shows what each person owes. An order can be shared by the whole table or only by the people you pick.
faq.edit_me_q: Can I change my name, photo or note?
faq.edit_me_a: Yes. Once you've joined your table, tap your row on the People tab to edit it. Notes like "no shrimp" are visible to everyone.
faq.switch_table_a: Tap the door button next to Copy link to leave, then open the right table and join it with its code. A phone can only hold one table's code at a time.
faq.feedback_q: Where do I leave feedback or photos?
faq.feedback_a: On the Feedback page. Write something, add a photo if you like, and post it for everyone to see.
